sloka: एते दोषा मम भ्रातुर्जीवितैश्वर्यनाशनाः।गुणान् प्रच्छादयामासुः पर्वतानिव तोयदाः।दोषैरेतैः परित्यक्तो मया भ्राता पिता तव ।। ६.८७.२६ ।।
transliteration: ete doṣā mama bhrāturjīvitaiśvaryanāśanāḥ।guṇān pracchādayāmāsuḥ parvatāniva toyadāḥ।doṣairetaiḥ parityakto mayā bhrātā pitā tava ।। 6.87.26 ।।

translations.english: "Because of these faults your father and my brother has been abandoned by me from this Lanka. This Lanka will not be there, nor your father and you too."
